t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The amount of mushrooms you receive depend on the supply. After a while, the supply will start to run out on certain ones. The best way is to keep picking the same basket. One of them is linked to red, brown, pink and another colour. Once the supply begins to run out (ie you get 1 or 2 a few times) switch to the other coloured basket.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 different baskets that you can choose from. These are yellow and red. You will only see the basket colour on the 2nd page when you select space. To choose the basket, the have to choose the corresponding coloured gnome. The yellow basket is linked with the yellow, blue, green and orange gnomes. The red basket is linked with the red, brown, purple and pink gnomes. The baskets supply of mushrooms will eventually start to run out and you will realise this by only getting 0 or 1 mushrooms per pick. So once you start, choose one of the 4 linked colours and if it's good, keep choosing those 4 until the supply starts decreasing. If you only get 0 or 1 from your first pick, switch to the other colours.
